changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionMetric') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionMetric]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [AssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [MetricAssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [EffectiveDate] [date] NOT NULL, [Result] [bit] NOT NULL, [IsValidAsset] [bit] NULL, [IsValidMetric] [bit] NULL, [IsValidMetricDate] [bit] NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, [IsValidAllocation] [bit] NULL, [Value] [decimal](5, 3) NULL, [RunDate] [datetime] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionMetric] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] ASC, [ItemNumber] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionMetric_AssetUid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionMetric_AssetUid] ON [api].[ExecutionMetric] ( [AssetUid] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionMetric_MetricAssetUid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionMetric_MetricAssetUid] ON [api].[ExecutionMetric] ( [MetricAssetUid] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionMetric_Success') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionMetric_Success] ON [api].[ExecutionMetric] ( [Success] ASC ) END
